why_it_fails: Stage: website discovery. (1) locators.CONNECTORS has no Ascend entry, so _known_menu_candidates returns "No retailer locator connector configured for this brand"; the anchored regex style used elsewhere (^curaleaf\b, ^rise\b) would not match "Midway by Ascend" anyway because the brand is a suffix. (2) The fallback search (search_websites by address) requires street_in_text(registry street) in a result block; Ascend publishes 5650, the registry has 5648, so even a working search could not corroborate it. Per the lead, the fallback web search is currently dead (DuckDuckGo returns a 202 bot challenge, Bing returns unrelated pages); the stored evidence for this store is a Bing 200 plus a DuckDuckGo ConnectTimeout. (3) Even with the right URL, the Dutchie reader enforces the platform-declared street via locators.addresses_match: 5648 vs 5650 would raise BRANCH_MISMATCH ("different street address") unless an operator exception exists (see ACCEPTED_STREET_MISMATCHES in backend/providers/generic.py, commit b077228). The registry pin is also ~1.4 mi off so _pinned() cannot rescue it.
